hardware_compatibility.measurement_structure: Computational-basis measurement on all qubits, matching SamplerV2's counts-based output -- no mid-circuit measurement or conditional logic, which keeps the circuit compatible with standard Sampler primitive execution on real hardware.
hardware_compatibility.parameter_binding_note: Feature-map parameters are bound per-sample (data), ansatz parameters are bound once after training (frozen weights) -- this split is exactly what Phase 2's 'train locally, freeze, then run inference circuits on hardware' design in the master plan requires.
hardware_compatibility.note: This is a STATIC transpilation check against a generic IBM-typical basis gate set -- it does NOT reflect a specific real device's coupling map, calibration, or noise, and no Fake Backend or real hardware was used.
